title: Marketing Manager (DTC e-Commerce Business)
subtitle: About PATI Group
body:
## About PATI Group

PATI is a fast-growing E-commerce business specializing in dietary supplements, achieving a remarkable 500% increase in sales within just one year in the United States market. 

We're on a mission to become the leading dietary supplement company in Vietnam by 2026, offering innovative and high-quality products that inspire our customers to optimize their physical, mental, and intellectual potential.

As we continue our rapid growth trajectory, we're seeking a visionary** Marketing Manager (DTC e-Commerce Business)** to lead our marketing efforts and drive us towards these goals.

## Job Summary

Are you ready to take the lead in scaling a high-potential e-commerce brand to the next level?

PATI Group is looking for a **Marketing Manager** to spearhead our Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) growth across the Men’s Health and Women’s Health collections. In this high-impact role, you’ll **take full ownership of end-to-end DTC performance**, and be the strategic driver behind our ambitious goal of reaching **$50M in annual revenue within the next 2–3 years. **

This is a unique opportunity for **a data-driven, results-oriented marketer **who thrives in a fast-paced, growth-focused environment and is ready to make a real difference.

## **Core Responsibilities**

- **Team Growth:** Collaborate with Marketing Operations team of 2-3 to drive DTC growth by 2025.

- **Agencies Management**: Manage performance agencies (Email, Google Ads, Amazon) to drive growth.

- **Product Launch Success: **Work cross functionally with different stakeholders to prepare for product launch, optimization, and scale.

## **Requirements**

### **Must-Have Requirements**

- **Experience: Minimum 10 years of hands-on experience** in DTC e-commerce marketing with **a proven track record** in performance growth.

- Master’s degree or MBA in Marketing, Business Administration, or related fields.

- **Website & Landing Page Execution:**

Familiar with **Shopify** & landing page builders like: **Gempage, Replo, PageFly**.

- **Candidate must be willing and able to build landing pages & configure website** on your own.

- **Technical Skills:** Hands-on experience with Meta Ads, Google Ads, Email Marketing, TikTok Ads, and CRO tools.

- Solid grasp of **budget planning and allocation** - able to manage **~1 billion VND/month** efficiently.

- Must be **comfortable with** performance analysis; **good mental math is a plus**.

- Demonstrate strong **action-oriented thinking **(HOW) and **strategic thinking **(WHY) in decision-making.

- **Candidate Type:** Plug-and-Play candidate only; no room for "potential" candidates with no practical experience.

### **Behavioral Competencies**

- **Integrity:** The No. 1 required quality.

- **Data-Driven Decision-Making:** Ability to make unemotional, logic-based decisions, while leading with authenticity and empathy.

- **Discipline:** High level of discipline with zero tolerance for undisciplined behavior.

- **Mentorship:** Ability to lead by example and develop junior team members into high performers.

- **Psychological Understanding:** Understanding how performance creatives work for each ad platform.

- **Listening Skills:** Ability to make others feel heard and valued during discussions and team interactions.

- Alignment with our core values and behaviors. Read more about our culture here: [https://www.patigroup.com/t/culture](https://www.patigroup.com/t/culture).

### **Nice-to-Have Requirements**

- **Regional Experience:** Experience with U.S. or EU e-commerce markets.

- **Technical Skills:** Experience with Klaviyo and marketing automation tools.

- **Growth Experience:** Experience working in hyper-growth environments or startups scaling from Series A to Series C.

## **Compensation and Benefits**

- **Income: **Up to 55,000,000 VND per month + incentive based on performance (open to negotiate). 

- **Performance Bonuses:**

**Monthly Bonus:** If the team achieves a $1M net profit target, bonuses of $1K-$3K are paid monthly.

- **Annual Bonus:** This can be up to 10 months of salary, based on performance measured by net profit, SOP, and adherence to cultural key behaviors.

- **Equity Offer:** Potential to transition into a Head of Media / Marketing Director role with an equity offer.

## Team Management

- **Reports to:** CEO.

- **Career Path:** Potential promotion to Marketing Director based on performance.

- **Current team dynamic:** 3 Marketing Operators, working with cross-functional Community & Affiliate team and 4 performance marketing agencies.

- Expected team size by 2026: 5-6 Marketing Operators (3 Assistant Managers and 3 Senior Associates).

## Working Location

- On-site, 18 Street No. 38, An Khanh Ward, Thu Duc, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam.

## Working Hours

- **Monday - Friday:** 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM, with 1-hour lunch break.

- **Saturday (Culture Day):** 6:30 AM to 09:00 AM. We kick off Saturdays with team runs and weekly reflections - mind, body, and momentum aligned.

*(Make sure you have read and agreed to our working location and hours, including joining our Saturday activities.)*
